title: Cash Pickup Shortfall Re-issue: Window Base Set From the Original Last Day of Collection
content:
**Desk guidance.** On a Cash Pickup transfer, the window given to a re-issue of a shortfall is built on a window base. The base follows the last day of collection of the original pickup window.

**Days left.** The days left are the calendar days from the day of the re-issue to the original last day of collection. The re-issue day itself is not counted. When the original last day is the re-issue day, 0 days are left. When it is already past, the original window has passed.

## Decision table

| Original pickup window on the re-issue day | Window base of the re-issue |
|---|---|
| Not passed, with 15 or more days left | exactly the days left, so the re-issue keeps the original last day of collection |
| Not passed, with fewer than 15 days left (0 to 14) | the days left plus 15 top-up days |
| Already passed (the original last day is before the re-issue day) | the full pickup window of the transfer's tier, counted afresh from the re-issue day |

The keep threshold is 15 days and the top-up is 15 days. The base is a whole number of calendar days, counted from the day of the re-issue.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical original last day 30 June; hypothetical 30-day tier window)

| Re-issue day | Days left | Window base | Last day the base reaches |
|---|---|---|---|
| 10 June | 20 | 20 | 30 June |
| 15 June | 15 | 15 | 30 June |
| 16 June | 14 | 29 | 15 July |
| 30 June | 0 | 15 | 15 July |
| 1 July | window passed | 30 | 31 July |

The rows for 15 June and 16 June sit on either side of the 15-day threshold. A re-issue on 30 June still falls within the original window, because the last day itself has not passed.
